# 📚 CI/CD - GitHub Actions

Automatic deployment using Docker Hub.

## Files

- **[deploy.yml](deploy.yml)** - GitHub Actions workflow
- **[SETUP.md](SETUP.md)** - 5-minute setup guide

## Quick Start

1. Add 5 GitHub secrets
2. Update `kubernetes/app.yaml` with your Docker Hub username
3. `git push origin main` = auto-deploy! ✨

See **[SETUP.md](SETUP.md)** for details.
